body.x: Crosshub, Inc. (CEO Jay Jaeseol Kim) participated on Tuesday, the 28th, in the ‘Global Media Meetup’ hosted for domestic companies and startups by AVING News’ ‘International Press Club (IPC)’ at the MIK Base Camp in Seocho-gu, Seoul.

Running for four days from July 27 to 30, this ‘Global Media Meetup’ focuses on introducing products and technologies of domestic companies and startups to the global market. In particular, it aims to report product and technology information of companies participating in global exhibitions, including CES 2027, through global media in advance and expand business opportunities. Hae-in Jung, Head of North America, and Eun Joo Lee, Head of Overseas Business, delivered the presentation for Crosshub on this day.

Headquartered in Yeouido, Seoul, Crosshub is a DeepTech innovator delivering identity verification, digital payment infrastructure, and AI security solutions across 20 countries. Founded as an AI and blockchain technology leader, the company bridges Web2 and Web3 ecosystems through full-stack authentication, biometric AI, and digital identity platforms. Crosshub expands its trust platform ecosystem globally through hubs in Silicon Valley in the US, Paris in France, Tokyo in Japan, and Hanoi in Vietnam. The company won the ‘Best of Innovation’ award in the FinTech category at CES 2026 with its Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI)-based identity authentication solution ‘IDBlock’ and payment API infrastructure ‘B-Pay’. At this meetup, it introduced its voice AI payment security technology ‘V·Pay’ and university digital credential ‘Smart ID’. Building on its global momentum, Crosshub is actively preparing to exhibit at CES 2027 in Las Vegas and submit its latest innovations for the CES 2027 Innovation Awards.

body.cap: Voice payment authentication ‘V·Pay’ by Crosshub | Image provided by Crosshub

body.x: V·Pay is a ‘triple voice authorization’ technology targeting screenless or AI agent-driven payment environments. When a high-risk transaction occurs—such as payments, high-value transfers, logins, or account recoveries—it simultaneously verifies registered devices, speaker voiceprints, and dynamic one-time authorization phrases within 1.2 seconds. Instead of simple voice-command recognition, V·Pay verifies one-time spoken phrases by analyzing both speech content (“what was approved”) and frequency, intonation, and pronunciation patterns (“who approved it”). Because the system generates a new phrase for every transaction, recording, replay attacks, or AI-generated voice cloning cannot pass verification. Designed to link with existing wallet and merchant apps via mobile SDKs and APIs without separate dedicated hardware, it features a risk-adaptive structure that requests additional step-up authentication only when detecting anomalies. Currently finishing MVP development, the company is preparing for commercialization through Proof of Concept (PoC) testing in financial and payment sectors.

Hae-in Jung, Head of North America at Crosshub, explained, “If voice assistants on mobile phones specialize in searches or device control, V·Pay serves as a payment-dedicated authentication layer that verifies not only ‘what was authorized’ but also ‘who authorized it at the exact moment the payment is processed.’” She added, “Starting as an additional authentication method for high-risk, high-value transactions, we will expand it into a core authorization tool for screenless payments and AI agent commerce, such as drive-thrus, in-vehicle payments, and smart glasses.” She also presented a concept connecting the moment a user reads brand names or campaign phrases aloud to a new spoken targeted advertising revenue model.

body.cap: Digital student ID ‘Smart ID’ by Crosshub | Provided by Crosshub

body.x: ‘Smart ID’, presented second, is an AI-based digital identity and credential platform that connects university campuses to smart cities. Engineered with a 3-layer security framework (Self-Sovereign Identity, Zero-Knowledge Proofs, and IDBLOCK), it converts university-approved academic statuses into ‘W3C Verifiable Credentials’. During enrollment, it unifies access, attendance, library usage, dormitory control, and academic administration onto a single mobile ID. Adopting a ‘Retrofit-First’ approach that links via APIs and SDKs without replacing existing university databases or readers, it realizes minimal data disclosure principles by reducing personal information exposure by up to 90 percent. Smart ID integrates seamlessly with local Vietnamese e-wallets (VNPay, MoMo, ZaloPay) and global payment networks for tuition, cafeteria, and off-campus partner purchases. Crosshub is targeting Vietnam as its first market, conducting PoC testing with three local universities in Da Nang, Ho Chi Minh City, and Hanoi, before expanding into smart city infrastructure, automated AIoT flip gates, and intelligent public buildings. Eun Joo Lee, Head of Overseas Business at Crosshub, said, “Our goal is to connect fragmented campus data into one, realizing ‘lifelong credentials’ that prove school resources and qualifications without repeated authentication even 10 or 20 years after graduation.” In addition, Crosshub expands its trust infrastructure through ‘Travel Pass’ (Travel-K smart wallet for visitors), ‘Smart RAG’ (an evidence-based AI engine for task automation), and ‘KPOP PRO’ (a global fandom platform).

In South Korea, Crosshub collaborates with major financial institutions including Woori Bank, IBK Industrial Bank of Korea, Shinhan Bank, and KakaoBank, executing support projects for the Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT), Ministry of SMEs and Startups (MSS), Seoul Metropolitan Government, KOTRA, Korea Tourism Organization, and Korea Credit Guarantee Fund. Recognized as a 2026 Next-Generation Unicorn by MSIT, it accumulated 2 million USD (3.05 billion KRW) in investments from 7 investors, including MYSC, Krypton, Y&Archer, Zetaplan, and ThinkZone. The company plans to seek collaboration opportunities with global fintech partners, payment gateways (PGs), tech companies, and educational institutions through its participation in CES 2027, while refining core engines such as voice AI and Smart RAG through Series A investment attraction.

AVING News has promoted South Korean companies worldwide through media partnerships with over 800 outlets across 54 countries over the past 22 years. Building upon its global media network, AVING News newly launched the ‘International Press Club (IPC)’ last August. Global US IT and tech media outlet Ubergizmo participated in this ‘Global Media Meetup’.
